sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Model Card (September 26, 2025)
sources.evidence: The exact-model card describes a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer, optional thinking, multimodal inputs and text output. It separately identifies the September 2025 preview. Its architecture section and comparison tables give no total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite — Gemini API
sources.evidence: Exact stable ID gemini-2.5-flash-lite: 1,048,576 input tokens; text, image, video, audio and PDF inputs; text output; thinking and function calling supported. Page updated September 22, 2026 describes access limited to previous users; this is documentation, not an endpoint test.

sources.title: We’re expanding our Gemini 2.5 family of models
sources.evidence: June 17, 2025 announcement makes the Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite public preview available through AI Studio and Vertex AI, establishing the earliest public release.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is now stable and generally available
sources.evidence: July 22, 2025 announcement introduces stable gemini-2.5-flash-lite and explicitly says it is the same underlying model as the prior preview. It documents optional reasoning, million-token context and use through AI Studio and Vertex AI.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Google’s proprietary API terms govern model access and prohibit extracting model components, including parameter weights. No open-weight license is offered by these service terms.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: The linked 73-page training report describes sparse MoE Transformers, but its comparison table covers 2.5 Pro/Flash and 2.0 Flash-Lite rather than 2.5 Flash-Lite. It provides no exact-model total or active count; sibling figures are not transferred.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Model Card (March 2026)
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison tables include Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Dynamic with benchmark, throughput and price results, but no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite Model Card (July 2026)
sources.evidence: Later Flash-Lite card and comparison table checked for retrospective disclosures; it documents 3.5/3.1 and does not disclose 2.5 Flash-Lite parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card (October 2026)
sources.evidence: Latest-generation first-party architecture and evaluation sections checked; they contain no retrospective total or active parameter count for Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite.

sources.title: Model versions and lifecycle — Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
sources.evidence: Lists gemini-2.5-flash-lite stable release on July 22, 2025 and Agent Platform retirement on October 20, 2026. Stable ID release is distinguished from the earlier preview of the same model.

sources.title: Learn about supported models — Firebase AI Logic
sources.evidence: Lists July 22, 2025 as the stable ID release and shutdown warnings for October 16, 2026 (Developer API) / October 20, 2026 (Agent Platform). The Developer API warning conflicts with the exact API page’s ongoing-access notice; no live availability claim is made.

name.note: Official exact-model title, preserving Flash-Lite punctuation.

developer.note: Google publishes and distributes the model; the development organization is Google DeepMind.

family.note: Retain the catalog’s normalized Flash-Lite subfamily key; official materials identify the Gemini 2.5 family and Flash-Lite variant.

release_date.note: Earliest public preview availability is June 17. The stable API ID launched July 22, but the GA announcement explicitly identifies the same underlying model. September Preview (09-2025) is a separate later variant.

open_weights.note: Google distributes this model through proprietary hosted APIs, with no public checkpoint or open-weight license in the reviewed release and model documentation.

license.note: Descriptive service/model licensing classification; Gemini API terms govern access. Documentation footer CC BY and sample-code Apache licenses do not license model weights.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total count is disclosed in the exact model card or checked later first-party cards/comparison tables. Exact-name training and interpretability searches found no first-party count; no estimate is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: The exact-model card says a subset of experts is activated per token, without a numeric active count. Checked later primary sources do not supply one; total and active size are not equated.

architecture.note: The exact Flash-Lite card explicitly describes sparse mixture-of-experts Transformers with native text, vision and audio input support. Detailed expert/layer counts are not supplied.

context_window.note: Exact API documentation labels this the input-token limit. The 65,536 output-token limit is a separate quantity.

modalities.note: Exact stable model table explicitly lists each input and text output; audio/image generation and Live API are not supported.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported and optionally enabled; support does not imply it is always enabled.

tool_call.note: Exact stable-model capabilities table explicitly supports function calling.

description.value: Gemini 2.5 multimodal model with optional thinking and function calling.
description.note: Directly documented input scope and optional capabilities, without comparative performance or price claims.

patch.notes: First public preview: June 17, 2025. Stable API ID: July 22; Google explicitly says it uses the same underlying model. September Preview (09-2025) is separate. Sparse MoE Transformer; total and active parameter counts are undisclosed. Availability documentation conflicts: the API page retains access for previous users while Firebase lists an October 16, 2026 shutdown warning.

summary: Verified all 14 public fields. Add primary-source sparse MoE Transformer architecture and proprietary licensing; replace informal description. Preserve June 17, 2025 as earliest public release because Google explicitly equates the June preview with the July stable underlying model. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after exact-card, later-card/comparison and first-party research searches. Confirm 1,048,576-token input, five input formats, text output, optional thinking and function calling. Current service-availability documentation conflicts are recorded without asserting endpoint operation.
